description: This file declares the interface for the IARM-Bus API, including function signatures, types, and documentation for inter-process communication, event handling, and RPC mechanisms within the RDK platform.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_Init
methods.description: Initializes the IARM-Bus library with a given client name.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_Term
methods.description: Terminates the IARM-Bus library and releases resources.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_Connect
methods.description: Connects the application to the IARM bus daemon.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_Disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the application from the IARM bus.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_GetContext
methods.description: Retrieves the group context of the calling member.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_BroadcastEvent
methods.description: Publishes an asynchronous event to all registered clients.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_IsConnected
methods.description: Checks if a member is registered with IARM.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_RegisterEventHandler
methods.description: Registers an event handler for a specific event.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_UnRegisterEventHandler
methods.description: Removes all handlers for a specific event.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_Call_with_IPCTimeout
methods.description: Invokes an RPC method with a timeout.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_RegisterEvent
methods.description: Registers all events up to a maximum event ID.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_WritePIDFile
methods.description: Writes the process ID to a specified file.
